final: WITH moon_groups AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_group_usage FROM moon_groups), above_average AS (SELECT m.avg_usage, m.record_count, m.avg_usage - overall.avg_group_usage AS difference FROM moon_groups AS m CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_group_usage IS NOT NULL AND m.avg_usage > overall.avg_group_usage) SELECT AVG(avg_usage), SUM(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM above_average
